kpis.description_en: Inalum (Indonesian govt) holds 51% PT-FI (Grasberg) post 2018 divest. FCX retained 49% interest.

kpis_story.description_fr: Tailwind structurel cuivre: data center AI (1000 lbs/MW), grid expansion (+50% capex 2024-2030), EV adoption. Deficit supply structurel post-2027.
kpis_story.description_en: Structural copper tailwind: AI data center (1000 lbs/MW), grid expansion (+50% capex 2024-2030), EV adoption. Structural supply deficit post-2027.

kpis_story.description_fr: Nouvelle smelterie Manyar $3.7Md commissioned 2024-2025. Permet retention concentrate Indonesia + reduces export tax exposure.
kpis_story.description_en: $3.7B Manyar smelter commissioned 2024-2025. Allows Indonesia concentrate retention + reduces export tax exposure.

_notes: FCX = Freeport-McMoRan, #1 US copper producer + significant gold byproduct. Tailwind AI data center + EV + grid copper demand.
